record.title: microduck-m12-lens-holder
record.why: MEASURED 2026-09-02 (lane T): the shelf's own check FAILed this folder for declaring ZERO interfaces, and that is now settled — cad/interfaces.json declares three MEASURED anchors — 'lens_bore' (Ø11.6000 x 7.4980 at (0.0000, 10.5490, 0.0000)), 'mount_screws' (2 x Ø2.0000 x 3.6000, 20.0000 mm apart) and 'focus_lock' (a single Ø2.0000 x 1.8870 radial grub-screw hole breaking into the bore) — all read off Pollen's m12_lens_holder.stl at 0.0000 mm fit residual and 355.0 deg cover, frozen in out/laneT/features/m12_lens_holder.json. WHAT IS STILL MISSING, named rather than left as 'nothing measured yet': cad/part.py is still the `bin/triad new part` SKELETON and builds no geometry. And WHAT THIS HOLDER BOLTS TO IS NOT IDENTIFIED: its 'mount_screws' are 2 x Ø2.0000 20.0000 mm apart, while part:microduck-face-part's 'camera_mount' is a 13.5000 x 21.0000 mm rectangle of 4 x Ø1.6000 — a different pattern, so those two do not mate, and no other mesh in the reference carries a matching pair. What settles it: a photograph of the head interior.
record.origin_why: the geometry this folder describes is Pollen Robotics' own published sim asset (reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/), measured but not designed here; CC BY-SA-NC 4.0 per the pollen-robotics/microduck_rl README, so usable to assemble, render, simulate and print, NOT licensed for sale.
